context:
Goal: a report that admits a mistake names a PR, commit, step or debt, never a habit.
Problem (rule): "The builders broke X — Guard: future briefs run Y first." passes today with no ref.
Based on (read): lint/report_guard.py MISTAKE_FIRST_PERSON_RE counts only "I" and "my" as admitting a mistake.
Based on (ruling): decision mistake-means-missing-guard, Incident line ("named the builders, not I").
Departs from: main, where an admission needs "I" or "my" and the label must lead its sentence — widens the label forms, and option b also adds role subjects.

options.gain: Closes the dash form today, at the same cost as now.
options.how: Widen the label match: "Missing guard:", "(Guard:", and a label after a dash, comma or "and". Role subjects (builder, reviewer, lane, agent, we) become their own step, built only after their false alarms are measured.
options.label: More label forms now (lane's pick, Recommended)
options.lose: Until that step lands, "The builders broke X; future briefs run Y first." (no word guard, no I) still passes.

options.gain: Fixes the cause, so reworded admissions are caught with no model call.
options.how: As a, but a label after a dash only in the colon form, and "we" and the agent roles join "I" and "my" as subjects that admit a mistake. Measure false alarms on the test fixtures and recent final reports before building.
options.label: Labels plus role subjects (blind agent's pick)
options.lose: False alarms on lines like "the reviewer found the builder's test wrong" (unmeasured), and it changes the Incident line of your decision.

options.gain: No label forms to keep up.
options.how: Every sentence that contains "guard" must cite a PR, commit, step or debt.
options.label: Any sentence with the word guard
options.lose: False alarms on "guard_merge.py" and "the push guard refused it"; both agents reject it.

options.how: A model call judges each landed report for an admitted mistake with no ref.
options.label: A model reads each report
options.lose: One model call per report, results vary, and no fixed red proof; both agents reject it.

ref: your 10:57 CST answer on item 629; lane 11:01 CST with a blind agent

title: How should the check find a report that admits a mistake with no guard named?
why: You asked for an independent blind agent's view on 629. It picked differently from the lane, so both are here. This replaces 629.
